verdict.rationale: Blink's built-in local command set includes grep, which gives basic content search from within the product. However, the evidence never documents regex options, filters, or any fuzzy matching or code-navigation feature. The VS Code connection belongs to the remote editor, not Blink, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: fuzzy matching, documented regex and filter options, code navigation (jump to symbol or file), any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and navigate code content using fuzzy matching, filters, and regular expressions
